test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following statements is/are correct?

(i) Magnetic field strength is strongest at the centre of a bar magnet.

(ii) No two magnetic field lines can intersect.

(iii) Magnetic field lines always form closed continuous curves.
solution:
The correct answer is **'__Both (ii) and (iii)__'.**
